title: 247 Ashland Woodway Texas Branded
description: This beautiful home is in the well-desired area of Speefleville. Property features a peaceful setting located minutes from the convenience of Waco and surrounded by mature trees. The home is a spacious open floorplan with freshly painted walls, a large eat-in Kitchen which has lots of cabinetry and storage. Master suite and minor bedrooms are split between the large living-room. This property is the perfect place to make a home.
